heading.title: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts

article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article10Three years.



The Schedule · First Division—Suits · Part II—Suits Relating to Contracts



Against a carrier for compensation for losing or injuring goods.


Period of limitation
Three years.



Time from which period begins to run
When the loss or injury occurs.
